subject.title: [Bug]: Slack reaction_added/reaction_removed events never delivered via Socket Mode (multi-account, v2026.3.24)

question: Is the current report sufficient to authorize a code change, or should maintainers wait for the redacted live Socket Mode envelope and trace-log proof requested on July 6, 2026?
rationale: Current source and dependency inspection show several plausible boundaries, but not which one fails in the reporter's live multi-account setup; choosing a fix without that evidence would be speculative.

options.title: Wait for live envelope proof
options.body: Keep this issue open and require the requested raw envelope fields plus gateway logs before queueing any fix.

options.title: Add diagnostic-only instrumentation
options.body: A maintainer could sponsor a narrow diagnostics PR if waiting for reporter proof is too slow, accepting the operator log-volume and privacy tradeoffs.

options.title: Fold into the broader Socket Mode report
options.body: Close or route this under a broader Slack Socket Mode issue only if new evidence shows the same non-reaction-specific drop boundary.

recommendation.title: Wait for live envelope proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require the requested raw envelope fields plus gateway logs before queueing any fix.
